responsibility: Implements the Rust AST desugaring pass for the `?` error-propagation operator. It traverses selected expression-bearing statement and call contexts, detects `ErrorPropagationExpr` nodes, and replaces them in place with a `match` over `Try::into_result` expressed through lang-item paths, yielding the `Ok(val)` branch value or returning early via `Try::from_error(From::from(err))` on the `Err` branch; this file therefore owns the AST-level expansion of `?` into explicit control flow and trait/lang-item calls before lowering.
